tasks.title: build/solution/screens.json — set required:true on Username or email and Password fields of SCR-login
tasks.body:
Targets: build/solution/screens.json

### C1: build/solution/screens.json — set required:true on Username or email and Password fields of SCR-login

- Location: lines 131-155 — `fields` array of SCR-login
- Current:
```json
        {
          "name": "Username or email",
          "control": "text",
          "required": false,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        },
        {
          "name": "Password",
          "control": "password",
          "required": false,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        },
```
- New:
```json
        {
          "name": "Username or email",
          "control": "text",
          "required": true,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        },
        {
          "name": "Password",
          "control": "password",
          "required": true,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        },
```
- Why: The model is the authoritative source for screen field metadata; `required` must be true to reflect that sign-in cannot proceed without both values.

tasks.title: stories/EPIC-02a.json — set required:true on all four copies of Username or email and Password ui entries
tasks.body:
Targets: stories/EPIC-02a.json

### C2: stories/EPIC-02a.json — set required:true on all four copies of Username or email and Password ui entries

- Location: lines 111-128 (first story ui), 236-253 (second story ui), 323-340 (third story ui), 428-445 (fourth story ui) — each copy of the "Username or email" and "Password" ui entries with `"required": false`
- Current (repeated four times, two fields each):
```json
        {
          "screen": "SCR-login",
          "field": "Username or email",
          "control": "text",
          "required": false,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        },
        {
          "screen": "SCR-login",
          "field": "Password",
          "control": "password",
          "required": false,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        }
```
- New (same four occurrences, `"required": false` → `"required": true` for both fields in each):
```json
        {
          "screen": "SCR-login",
          "field": "Username or email",
          "control": "text",
          "required": true,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        },
        {
          "screen": "SCR-login",
          "field": "Password",
          "control": "password",
          "required": true,
          "validation": null,
          "example": null,
          "options": null
        }
```
- Why: Each story carries its own copy of the ui fields it exercises; all copies must match the model or the backlog contradicts itself.
